name: Arrowroot
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as a pure starch with minimal fermentable content, making it suitable for SIBO diets.
preparationTips: Mix with cold liquid before adding to hot mixtures to prevent lumping
Use as a 1:1 substitute for cornstarch in most recipes
Creates a glossy, clear finish when used as a thickener
Ideal for gluten-free baking when combined with other flours
nutritionalHighlights: Contains small amounts of iron and B vitamins
